crossRefs.note: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, or have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that…
Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and…
He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you, when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive…
Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
But godliness with contentment is great gain.

translations.web: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;
translations.bsb: Nor have we built houses in which to live, and we have not owned any vineyards or fields or crops.
translations.kjv: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
